prompt: The curve $x^{2}+xy+y^{2}=7$ passes through $(1,2)$. Find the gradient of the curve at this point.
A 5 m ladder leans against a vertical wall. The bottom slides away from the wall at $0.3$ m s⁻¹. Find how fast the top slides down the wall when the bottom is 3 m from the wall.
markscheme:
$x^{2}+y^{2}=25\Rightarrow2x\dfrac{dx}{dt}+2y\dfrac{dy}{dt}=0$ **(M1)(A1)**

At $x=3$, $y=4$: $3(0.3)+4\dfrac{dy}{dt}=0$ **(M1)**, $\dfrac{dy}{dt}=-0.225$: sliding down at $0.225$ m s⁻¹ **(A1)**

prompt: Air is pumped into a spherical balloon at $50\ \text{cm}^{3}\,\text{s}^{-1}$. Find the rate at which the radius increases when the radius is 10 cm.
Find the point on the curve $y=\sqrt x$ closest to $A(3,0)$, and the minimum distance.
markscheme:
$D^{2}=(x-3)^{2}+x$ — minimising $D^{2}$ is equivalent to minimising $D$ **(M1)(A1)**

$\dfrac{d}{dx}D^{2}=2(x-3)+1=0\Rightarrow x=\tfrac52$ **(A1)**

Point $\left(\tfrac52,\sqrt{\tfrac52}\right)$ **(A1)**; $D=\sqrt{\tfrac14+\tfrac52}=\dfrac{\sqrt{11}}{2}\approx1.66$ **(A1)**
